title: Work done in a worktree session reaches backlog.py cost as work rows
goal: A session that claims, lands or works an item from a git worktree outside the clone's checkout (../it-ops-kb-worker2) leaves work rows that distill delivers and backlog.py cost --rework reads, so an item's cost is not zero; a test plants a worktree session's claim and done and sees its work lines. Answers the SP-tpulmoxh retrospective: every item read 0 runs and 0 prompts, and land warned 'landed with no work rows' on each worker2 item.
